title: Tile Stone Bangle
descriptionHtml:
Square by square. A slim gold bangle built from a row of square tiles, about 4mm each, alternating plain polished gold with a round clear stone framed in a square bezel. Clean and graphic, it stacks easily.

STYLING TIP: Stack it with a fine chain bracelet so the square line has something soft beside it.

Details

  • Style: Slim rigid bangle
  • Pattern: Square tiles, approximately 4mm, alternating plain polished gold with a round clear stone in a square bezel
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
